description: This PHP source file defines the class ADODB_pdo_pgsql, a driver extension for PDO PostgreSQL within the ADODB database abstraction library. It provides SQL queries and methods specific to PostgreSQL database metadata retrieval, date/time handling, and transaction support.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_pgsql
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_pdo, providing PostgreSQL-specific database operation methods and SQL queries.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting transaction and insert ID capabilities.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset, with optional caching.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about database tables with optional schema filtering.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.
